description: Few-shot example generator — Generate realistic, varied few-shot examples (input/output pairs) for prompting or evaluating an LLM on any task, including edge cases. With labels= the outputs are forced to your exact labels and balanced across them; near-duplicate inputs and off-label outputs are dropped offline. Returns the examples, label counts, balance flag, input length stats and a ready-to-paste prompt block. Optional: labels= comma list, n= 2-12, format=, domain=. Nothing stored. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

task.description: e.g. Classify the sentiment of product reviews

name: ai_few_shot
